body:
## Summary

Gives `.card-title` a two-line `min-height` in [`quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss) so the guest/author name below the title aligns consistently across carousel cards, regardless of whether a title spans one or two lines.

- Added `min-height: calc(1.35em * 2)` to `.card-title` (line-height `1.35` × 2 lines).
- Uses `em` rather than `px`/`rem` so the reserved height scales with the font-size, keeping alignment correct at the sidebar breakpoint where `.card-title` is `0.85rem`.
- Existing two-line truncation (`-webkit-line-clamp: 2`, `overflow: hidden`) is preserved.

## Why

The `.episode-guest` name is absolutely positioned to the bottom of `.card-content`, so single-line titles previously left it sitting higher than on two-line cards. Reserving two lines of title height fixes the vertical misalignment without per-episode `guestOffset` tuning.

## Notes

No build/formatter was run — `node_modules` is not installed in this environment. The change is a single standard CSS property scoped to `episodeCarousel.scss`.

Closes #95

comments.body: This broke these episodes @sepo-agent
Maybe the alternative solution was to figure out what these episodes did and apply the same fix to Episode 7.

Found it. The two clipped cards are **EP00** and **EP01** — the only episodes with a non-zero `guestOffset`.

Here's the reply I'll post:

---

Good catch — I can reproduce the clipping from your screenshot. The guest names on **EP00 "Introducing The Augmented Mind"** and **EP01 "Bridging Human-AI Grounding Gaps"** are being pushed below the card edge and cut off by the card's `overflow: hidden`.

**Root cause:** the guest name is absolutely positioned at the bottom of `.card-content` and *also* nudged by a per-episode `guestOffset` frontmatter value ([`EpisodeCarousel.tsx:60,102`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx#L60-L102)). Only two episodes set it:

- [`content/episodes/ep00.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/content/episodes/ep00.md) → `guestOffset: 1.275`
- [`content/episodes/ep01.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/content/episodes/ep01.md) → `guestOffset: 1.275`

That `1.275rem` was a manual nudge calibrated against the *old* card height, to push single-line-title cards' guest names down to match two-line cards. This PR's new `min-height: calc(1.35em * 2)` on `.card-title` ([`episodeCarousel.scss:219`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/agent/implement-issue-95/claude-35403913204/quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss#L219)) now reserves that same extra line of height automatically — so the offset is applied **twice**, shoving the name out the bottom.

**Fix:** now that the min-height handles alignment, the manual offsets are redundant. Set `guestOffset: 0` (or remove the field) on `ep00.md` and `ep01.md`. That's the exact tuning the PR was meant to eliminate — it just missed updating the two content files that still carry the old value.

To apply it to this PR branch:

```
@sepo-agent /fix-pr Set guestOffset to 0 on content/episodes/ep00.md and ep01.md so the min-height change aligns the guest names without double-offsetting
```
